text:
oncall-bot: PAGE: gpu-pool alert — queue depth for pool 'prod-gpu-1' > 12k, avg latency > 4s, autoscaler not launching new nodes. Priority: P1 :rotating_light:
marcus: I'm on it. Seeing a sudden spike in pending pods. Autoscaler metrics show scale_attempts=0 for last 6m despite backlog.
anya: Logs show a lot of kubelet registration timeouts + driver Xid 31 around the same time. Copying snippet:
```
Kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 31, pid=2222, pte=00007f...
containerd: runtime completed with error: exit status 137 (OOM?)
```
marcus: autoscaler events: "Reached max size: 40" — cloud quota maybe? Current pool size = 40, desired = 60.
dmitri: Confirmed — cloud account quota for GPU cores at limit. Also seeing several nodes flapping: node/gpu-node-17 NotReady -> Ready -> NotReady. Might be driver crashloop causing loses of effective capacity.
cori: @marcus @anya we need rapid mitigations: 1) divert traffic away from affected pool 2) apply emergency rate-limits for heavy orgs 3) attempt node reboot/drain where driver crashed.
marcus: Starting routing change now — shifting new incoming requests to 'prod-gpu-2' and 'prod-cpu-fallback' with lower concurrency. Will update routes config.
anya: Rolling through driver logs — CUDA OOM + Xid entries concentrated on pods using model 'redwood-large-quant'. Suspect memory fragmentation with long-lived KV caches.
samir: Oncall handover in 10. Cori can you take lead if I need to drop into infra?
cori: I got it. Samir reassigning.
anya: Running quick query on pod allocation: `kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide | grep Pending | wc -l` -> 688 pending.
marcus: Applying temporary throttle: add request header based rate-limit for orgs with >5k rps. Patch in proxy in 30s.
dmitri: Attempting soft fix on flapping nodes: `kubectl drain gpu-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data` then restart nvidia-driver daemonset on node. If driver module won't come up, cordon and evict.
anya: Trying kernel module reload: `kubectl exec -it daemonset/nvidia-driver -n infra -- /usr/local/bin/reload-driver.sh` on afflicted nodes. Some nodes report "module not found" — indicates partial driver upgrade mismatch.
cori: Ops plan: 1) route away from pool, 2) throttle high-volume customers, 3) cordon and drain 4 nodes at a time, 4) request emergency quota bump from cloud if autoscaler needs to expand beyond 40.
marcus: Route change propagated. New requests should hit prod-gpu-2 and cpu-fallback. Monitor: replication lag for embeddings service is low.
samir: Customer impact note: approx 8% of inference requests are failing with 502/timeout during the spike window. A subset of high-throughput customers saw elevated latencies and partial throttling.
dmitri: After draining gpu-node-17, driver daemon restarted but we saw two containers evicted with OOMKilled. Need to escalate a mandatory restart of long-lived model servers to clear KV caches.
anya: Proposed quick script to restart model servers with graceful ramp:
```
for svc in model-server-*-prod; do
  kubectl rollout restart deploy/$svc -n inference
  sleep 30
done
```
marcus: I'm cautious about rolling all at once — will do canary on one AZ first.
cori: Samir please draft a short customer-facing note: what happened, who affected, mitigations and ETA. Keep it factual and not alarmist.
samir: Drafting now — will post in #general after final confirmation.
anya: Infra requested kernel logs for nodes 12-18. Uploading to infra ticket INF-993.
dmitri: Manual quota request to cloud support submitted (case 012345). If approved we can expand pool to desired 60; otherwise we must keep routing limits in place.
marcus: Observability: token-level cost dashboards spiked due to retries. Will add a quick filter to identify top callers to throttle further if needed.
cori: Status check in 10m. Current mitigations: routing change done, partial drains in progress, driver restarts on 4 nodes, throttle rules applied. Impact: degraded latency and 502s for ~8% requests. Next actions: continue node repairs, follow quota request, restart model servers canary.
oncall-bot: Incident updated: severity P1 -> mitigation in progress. Assigned: cori (oncall). Links: INF-993, cloud case 012345.
marcus: Rebooted gpu-node-19 successfully, driver came back clean. Pool available capacity +4. Pending queue dropped from 688 -> 520.
anya: After canary restart of model-server-alpha, Xid errors reduced on that AZ. Looks like older driver pods were the root.
dmitri: Keep an eye on autoscaler logs: `kubectl -n kube-system logs deploy/autoscaler` — seeing repeated "scale suppressed: nodeGroup at max" until quota resolves.
cori: Good progress. If cloud approves quota in next 30m we can scale up and expedite backlog clearing.
samir: I'll prepare incident postmortem template and start capturing timelines. Also noting action item: add guard against driver kernel/driver mismatch during rolling upgrades.
marcus: Will schedule a dedicated runbook update: add steps for immediate route diversion + canary model server restart + quota playbook.
anya: For now, Xid/OOMs appear correlated with long-lived KV cache usage + driver version mismatch. Postmortem check: upgrade testing matrix and canary driver rollout.
cori: All right teams — keep updates in thread only. Next update at 1802000600. Thanks for quick coordination. :thumbsup:
